subject: [Action needed] Deal stabilization: GPU standby request for Skyline Partners
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha@skylinepartners.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deal stabilization: GPU standby request for Skyline Partners

Team —

Skyline (attached SOW draft) is in the last stage of legal and they asked us to "soft hold" capacity while they finalize billing/PO. They want firm access to a steady pool for July–Sept production if the contract signs. Key asks: sustained 300 tokens/sec gen at 2k context for inference-heavy pipelines, and ability to spike 3x for short periods.

Can ops confirm:
- How many equivalent H100/A100 cards we should reserve for a soft-standby?
- Whether we can earmark capacity for ~8 weeks without an upfront commitment (internal hold policy)?
- Any risk to other runway deals if we provision this?

I attached the latest SOW and a request from Skyline. I want a recommendation by EOD today so I can respond to Aisha.

Thanks,
Rohan
Director, Growth — Redwood Inference

Attachments: Skyline_SOW_v3.pdf (draft), request_summary.docx (see Drive link)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha@skylinepartners.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deal stabilization: GPU standby request for Skyline Partners

On Tue, 20 Mar 2028 at 09:12 AM Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Skyline (attached SOW draft) is in the last stage of legal and they asked us to "soft hold" capacity while they finalize billing/PO.

Rohan —

Quick snapshot from fleet (as of 2028-03-20):
- Free fully-available A100-80GB equiv units: 36
- Free H100-80GB equiv units: 14
- Short-term (2–6 week) reclaimable pool: ~10 A100 equiv (dependent on scheduled rollouts)

Based on their throughput ask, I estimate a production family of ~4 H100 equiv for sustained latency targets (with autoscale to 8 for spikes). If they need guaranteed headroom without a billing commitment, we should convert this to an internal "soft-standby" allocation: mark capacity as reserved in the planner, flag priority preemption rules (only preempt if hard outage), and set a 6–8 week window.

Risks: scheduling one H100 cluster for 8 weeks impacts two small PLG accounts in our runway; we can mitigate by offering mixed-quantization profiles (8-bit quant) to reduce footprint to 3 H100-equivalent.

I'll attach the fleet snapshot CSV and a short runbook for a soft-hold.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Capacity Planning — Redwood Inference

Attachments: gpu_inventory_snapshot_20280320.csv
From: Aisha Khan <aisha@skylinepartners.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Glass <tom.glass@skylinepartners.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Mar 2028 14:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deal stabilization: GPU standby request for Skyline Partners

Thanks Rohan, Marissa —

Appreciate the quick look. Confirming Skyline's intent: if legal executes the SOW by 03/31 we will accept a short-term onboarding period and then convert to a committed monthly plan starting July 1. The PO timeline is tight; finance needs a buffer that guarantees we won't be bounced during the first 8 weeks of ramp.

For sizing, our infra team is comfortable with the 4 H100 equiv baseline, and we prefer to err on the side of extra headroom. If you can provide a soft-standby hold and cost impact estimate (delta if we go committed vs soft-hold) that would help speed internal approvals.

Cheers,
Aisha Khan
VP of Infrastructure — Skyline Partners
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha@skylinepartners.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deal stabilization: GPU standby request for Skyline Partners

On Tue, Mar 20, 2028 at 02:18 PM Aisha Khan <aisha@skylinepartners.com> wrote:
> For sizing, our infra team is comfortable with the 4 H100 equiv baseline, and we prefer to err on the side of extra headroom.

Team — operational proposal (short):

Option A — Soft-standby, minimal headroom (lower cost, moderate risk)
- Reserve: 4 H100-equivalent nodes (non-billed internal hold)
- Autoscale policy: allow spikes to 8 for up to 15 minutes, then scale down
- Preemption: high-priority for production; set bump-to-evict policy only for enterprise SLAs
- Expected impact: consumes 4 H100 equiv from pool; reclaimable with 48–72h notice

Option B — Soft-standby with quantization optimization (reduced footprint)
- Reserve: 3 H100-equivalent nodes + 1 quantized A100 profile (8-bit) to effectively cover spikes
- Benefit: reduces pressure on H100 pool; slightly higher inference latency for some models

Operational ask: Marissa/Marcus — can you create the internal hold ticket (soft-standby) in the resource planner for 6 weeks, flag it to Sales Ops, and provide estimated opportunity cost (estimated $/week) for both Option A and B? I'll draft the response to Skyline with clear trade-offs.

Thanks,
Dylan
Principal SRE — Redwood Inference
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha@skylinepartners.com>, Tom Glass <tom.glass@skylinepartners.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deal stabilization: GPU standby request for Skyline Partners

All — thanks for the fast turnaround and clear options.

Decision: proceed with Option B (soft-standby + quantization profile) as a 6-week internal hold window starting 2028-04-01 to 2028-05-12. Marissa — please file the internal hold ticket and attach the inventory snapshot; mark "soft-standby: Skyline Partners (SKY-4271)" and set reclaim notice 72h. Marcus — please calculate the estimated opportunity cost for the two options and drop it in the HubSpot deal record.

Aisha/Tom — I will confirm the hold and send a short note with cost deltas by EOD tomorrow. If legal signs earlier we will accelerate the conversion to a committed capacity contract.

Next steps:
- Marissa: create internal hold ticket + attach csv (action)
- Marcus: cost delta calc (action)
- Dylan: finalize autoscale/preemption settings (action)
- Rohan: send short note to Skyline with options and HubSpot link (action)

Rohan
Director, Growth — Redwood Inference
